title: refactor(plugin-grid): move ObjectGrid's row-height sync, column state and mobile affordances into sibling hooks (slice 7)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8KF8i7bmUmRJW1rodBW4KnP)_

Part of #25994 (slice 7 of the move-only split: regions C, D and E. Slices 1 to 6 have landed; slice 8, regions R, U and V, stays on the card and closes it.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 `ObjectGrid.tsx` 组件顶部三段代码(行高同步、列状态持久化、下拉刷新与卡片视图断点)原样搬进三个同目录 hook 文件,组件在原位置调用它们。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决「大文件互踩： 立重构卡把 ObjectView 和 ObjectGrid 拆成小模块。这个可以立卡」;这是第 7 片,文件从 5250 行降到 5160 行,并行卡更少撞在同一文件里。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,无逻辑、命名、渲染变化,hook 调用顺序不变;有问题直接 revert 本 PR 即可。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridColumnState.ts`(NON-AUTHOR SURFACE 注释仍紧贴 `columnState` 种子)、`ObjectGrid.tsx` 里三处调用、`gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx` 的路径改动。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2`,预期 253 个文件、2256 个测试全绿,与 main 相同。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Base `5cc31c78` (`origin/main`). `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is 5250 lines there. This slice moves regions **C**, **D** and **E** of the seam table in #26364, the three adjacent blocks at the top of the component body, verbatim into three custom hooks in new sibling modules:

| # | Concern | New home | Inputs | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C | Row-height sync: the effect that follows a changed `schema.rowHeight` | `useObjectGridRowHeightSync` in `objectGridRowHeight.ts` | `schema`, `rowHeightMode`, `setRowHeightMode` | nothing |
| D | Column-state persistence: `columnStorageKey`, the `columnState` seed with its NON-AUTHOR SURFACE comment, the external `columnState` sync, `saveColumnState` | `useObjectGridColumnState` in `objectGridColumnState.ts` | `schema`, `onColumnStateChange` | `columnState`, `saveColumnState` |
| E | Pull to refresh and the card-view breakpoint effect | `useObjectGridMobile` in `objectGridMobile.ts` | `schema`, `dataSource`, `setRefreshKey`, `setUseCardView` | `pullRef`, `isRefreshing`, `pullDistance` |

- `ObjectGrid` calls the three hooks exactly where the blocks stood, in the same order, so the component's hook order does not change. The state the blocks read or set (`rowHeightMode`, `refreshKey`, `useCardView`) stays in the component, and its setters are passed in.
- Inputs are typed from their source: setters as React's `Dispatch` of `SetStateAction` over the state's own type, `onColumnStateChange` as `ObjectGridExternalPaginationProps['onColumnStateChange']`, `dataSource` as `DataSource | undefined`. No context and no new `any`; the four `(schema as any).columnState` reads move as they were.
- Each hook returns only the names the rest of the component reads. `columnStorageKey`, `setColumnState`, `externalColumnStateKey` and `handlePullRefresh` have no reader outside their block, so they stay inside the hooks.
- Imports: `usePullToRefresh` moves with its only reader; the `type ObjectGridColumnState` import specifier leaves `ObjectGrid.tsx` (its only reader moved). The `export type { ObjectGridColumnState, … }` re-export is untouched, so the package entry and every exported name are unchanged.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` goes from 5250 to 5160 lines. The diff is 307 changed lines in 6 files.

**Move-only proof.** The multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectGrid.tsx` equals the new `ObjectGrid.tsx` plus the three modules. Missing: 1 line, the edited `./objectGridProps` import (it only lost the `type ObjectGridColumnState` specifier). Added: 81 lines, all of them the three module headers and docblocks, their imports, the three hook signatures and parameter types, the two `return { … }` lists, and in `ObjectGrid.tsx` the three new imports plus the three calls with their comments.

**No open PR touches these files.** I checked the 18 open PRs at the claim: only #26556 touches plugin-grid, and only its `package.json`.

## Why

The card's ruling, verbatim: 「大文件互踩： 立重构卡把 ObjectView 和 ObjectGrid 拆成小模块。这个可以立卡」. One move-only slice per PR, per the card's ask 1 to 5 and the hand-off notes on the card.

## Tests

One test edit, path-only, forced by the move:

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx`: the control case "and the four keys ruled in objectui#5091 still carry theirs" now reads `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `objectGridColumnState.ts` joined, because the NON-AUTHOR SURFACE comment on `columnState` moved with the seed it documents. The `onNavigate: onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate` read and its comment block stay in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, so the `gridLines` reads are unchanged. Assertions unchanged; one new path constant, one changed line.

No other test reads the moved lines as source. `columnStatePersistence` and `rowHeightOffSpecBoundary` are behavioural and render the real `ObjectGrid`, so they cover the hooks. I matched every string literal of every tracked test and script against the lines that left `ObjectGrid.tsx`; the hits outside `gridNonAuthorKeys` were generic words (`innerWidth`, `JSON.parse`, `@object-ui/mobile`) in behavioural tests or in gates that scan their own surfaces, and all of those ran green below.

## Acceptance notes

- Hook boundaries hide React lint findings, as on slices 4 to 6 (trap 3 of the hand-off). eslint on the four files: 0 errors; warnings 188 before, 189 after. `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on `setRowHeightMode` is no longer raised, because the rule only knows setters declared by `useState` in the same function: hidden, not fixed. `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` now names `setRefreshKey` (the pull-to-refresh `useCallback`) and `setUseCardView` (the breakpoint effect) as missing dependencies, for the same reason: a setter passed in as a hook parameter is not known to be stable. No dependency array changed. The other messages are the same findings at shifted lines or in the new module.
- Moved comments still say "`saveColumnState` below" and "the seed above" inside the new module, where they remain true; they are kept verbatim.
- The failure message of the re-pointed control case still says "gone from ObjectGrid.tsx"; it is left unchanged so the test edit stays path-only.

## Verification

Run on head `02d40dc8`:

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2` under the verification lock: 253 of 253 files, 2256 of 2256 tests after the move. Before: the same command on base `5cc31c78` (a separate worktree, deps built): 253 of 253 files, 2256 of 2256 tests.
- The 108 test files outside plugin-grid that read source trees (every ui test that reads files and names plugin-grid or walks the package roots): 108 of 108 files, 3152 of 3152 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'` (48 of 48 tasks).
- The Type Check UI job's 17 `check:*` steps plus `type-check:coverage`: all exit 0 (`check:spec-symbols` and `check:doc-example-readers` included; no new local type shares a spec name, and no single-return wrapper is exported).
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 35 derived commands, all exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock: 178 passed and 2 skipped files, 5065 passed and 2 skipped tests); `--ran` reconciles 35 of 35 (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN); the 18 Type Check UI commands above are recorded as outside the derivation.

Changeset: `.changeset/25994-objectgrid-column-state-mobile-hooks.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`).

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the touched files reports 0 errors.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer quick-read section and the quoted ruling are Chinese by rule).
